t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are set pairs of gnomes with one in each pair weighted to result in more mushrooms. however, at intervals the weighted gnome changes; it's unclear if this happens simultaneously for all pairs

vb_textbox.text: One of each of the four pairs of gnomes rewards more mushrooms, so try to keep a running mental list of the four colors that reward more. The pairings are the same throughout, but eventually which gnome rewards more from the pair will change. I tried to use the times when I would get the same pair back to back to experiment. As far as I could tell factors like reaction timing didn't make a difference
